title: Strawberry Lemon Tart with Walnut Crust
changes_from_base: A pressed walnut and breadcrumb crust in place of pastry, a simple baked lemon custard, and a jam-glazed strawberry top.
summary: A quick lemon tart with a nutty pressed walnut crust, glazed with jam and crowned with fresh strawberries.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Nut base
steps.text: heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan). Process the walnuts, breadcrumbs and 35 g sugar until finely ground but not pasty. Press over the base and sides of the tin and set it on the tray. Stop processing once fine; over-blended walnuts turn oily.

steps.title: Pre-bake
steps.text: bake about 10 min, until the edges just colour. Spread 40 g of the jam thinly over the base. Turn the oven down to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: whisk the eggs with the 165 g sugar, salt and lemon juice, then stir in the cooled butter.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: pour into the case and bake 30-35 min, until the filling is set with no liquid wobble in the centre. Cool to room temperature on the rack. Setting the tin on a tray catches any drips from the loose base.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: warm the remaining jam until runny, brush it over the top and arrange the strawberry halves in rings, cut side down. Serve the same day.

tips: Use the same jam for the base and the glaze so the flavours match.
Halve the berries just before arranging so they stay bright.
Let the filling cool fully before adding fruit, or the strawberries will weep.
storage: Best on the day. Chill leftovers, loosely covered, for up to 1 day.
